notes: Single-page monochrome exhibition site 'SHADES': hero canvas field, editorial statement, eight inline-SVG gallery works with lightbox, generative canvas process engine with regenerate/download, colophon. Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no dependencies, GitHub Pages ready. Respects prefers-reduced-motion, keyboard accessible. Known limitations: gallery SVG IDs are not namespaced across clones (cosmetic only); process canvas redraws are synchronous.
